summary_short: Krishna explains that selfless action is superior to inaction and is essential for spiritual growth.
summary_medium: Arjuna is confused about whether knowledge or action is better. Krishna clarifies that no one can avoid action and that selfless action, performed without attachment to results, purifies the mind and leads to liberation.
summary_detailed: Krishna resolves Arjuna’s confusion between renunciation and action.
He teaches that action is unavoidable for all living beings.
Selfless action (Karma Yoga) purifies the mind and prepares one for knowledge.
Krishna explains the importance of duty performed without desire.
He emphasizes that great people must act to set an example for society.
The chapter explains desire as the main enemy of wisdom.
Krishna urges disciplined action aligned with dharma.
what_you_learn: Why action is unavoidable in life.
The difference between selfless action and desire-driven action.
How desire and anger destroy wisdom.
How Karma Yoga leads to freedom.
